'''Lil' Rat''' is an enemy found in {{Chapter|The Alley}}. It is a basic rat.

Can be summoned as [[familiar]] through {{d|Toxoplasmosis}} or {{Set|Rat}}.

== Behavior ==
Attacks enemies by dashing in a cardinal direction (10 tile range). Will not dash if it cannot hit an enemy with the attack.

=== Tips ===
* Due to their very slow speed, '''Lil' Rats''' will likely be the last units to act in the round.

== Notes ==
* When exposed to {{el|Mutate|radiation}}, can mutate into:
** {{en|Lumpy}}
** {{en|Leaper}}

== Trivia ==
* Lil' Rats were one of the very first enemies created, even appearing in the very early stages of development when the team was still experimenting with the game's playstyle<ref>https://x.com/TylerGlaiel/status/1172215055401644032</ref>.
* The Lil' Rat and the {{en|Half-Rat}} are the only units that don't rely on the [[Catgen]] animation system to have an animation for being stunned.
